package.description: BitTorrent Acquisition & Keyword Aggregator, a terminal torrent search and download tool

en-US.description: BitTorrent Acquisition & Keyword Aggregator, a terminal torrent search and download tool
en-US.longDescription: Search public torrent indexers and download what you find, without leaving the terminal. One binary, no runtime to install. Downloads run in the background while you keep searching, finished downloads seed until you stop them, and every setting lives on one page inside the interface.
en-US.name: BAKA
